script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

Title: The Pursuit

FADE IN:

INT. BUSY KITCHEN - MORNING

A crowd of HIGH SCHOOL STUDENTS mill about, making breakfast, chatting and laughing. They all wear UNIFORMS. MRS. HANCOCK, the home economics teacher, stands at the front of the room, eyes twinkling.

MRS. HANCOCK
(cheerily)
Good morning, future chefs! Today we'll be making our signature dishes. What's your signature dish, Jake?

JAKE, a tall, quiet boy, looks down, shyly.

JAKE
(mumbling)
Pancakes.

MRS. HANCOCK
(smiling)
Ah, a classic! But I have a feeling you have more in you than just pancakes.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - LATER

The sound of bouncing basketballs fills the room. COACH JOHNSON, a stern but fair coach, watches his TEAM practice. JAKE enters, holding a basketball. He's new to the team, and his skill level is evidently low.

COACH JOHNSON
(looking Jake up and down)
You new here? Name's Johnson. You must be Jake. You've got heart, kid. But you need work.

JAKE
(determined)
I'll do whatever it takes, Coach.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - AFTERNOON

Jake sits alone, engrossed in a sports magazine. A WAITRESS approaches.

WAITRESS
(smiling)
Regular?

JAKE
(looking up)
Yes, please.

They exchange small talk. Waitress sets down his coffee.

WAITRESS
(noticing the magazine)
Basketball?

JAKE
(passionately)
More than that. It's my dream to play for the college team.

WAITRESS
(smiling)
You'll make it, Jake. I believe in you.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - NIGHT

Jake practices alone, shooting hoops. As he tires, he leans against the hoop, catching his breath. A figure approaches - LUCAS, a teammate.

LUCAS
(encouragingly)
You've got this, Jake. Don't give up.

Jake straightens, determined, and begins practicing again.

INT. SCHOOL AUDIATORIUM - WEEKS LATER

The school's annual basketball tournament is in full swing. The tension is palpable as Jake steps onto the court. His team is in the finals against their toughest competitors. Jake looks around, then focuses on the hoop.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - FINALS

The game is close, back and forth. With only seconds left, Jake takes the ball, dribbles, and shoots. The gym erupts in cheers as the ball swishes through the hoop.

FADE OUT:

TO BE CONTINUED...

THE END
